blocks.text: STO. DOMINGO, Ilocos Sur — Owners and operators of qualified agricultural trucks in the Ilocos Region may apply for fuel subsidy assistance through a registration caravan scheduled by the Department of Agriculture (DA) on Nov. 20 at the Farmers’ Productivity Center in this town. The subsidy is intended to help reduce fuel expenses and ease the cost of transporting agricultural products and essential farm inputs, supporting truck operators involved in moving goods across the region.
